user.title: Connect to Android TV
user.description:
1. On your Android TV, open Settings > Developer options > Wireless debugging > 'Pair device with pairing code' so the pairing dialog is active.
2. Enter the TV's IP address below (or paste the 'IP address & Port' from the dialog). Home Assistant will auto-detect the mDNS ports on the next step.

pair.title: Pair with Android TV
pair.description: Enter the 6-digit pairing code shown on your TV screen. The pairing and connect ports below were auto-detected via mDNS (or can be adjusted if using custom routing).

reauth_confirm.title: Re-pair Android TV
reauth_confirm.description: The ADB authorization key was revoked or expired. Open Wireless debugging > 'Pair device with pairing code' on your TV and enter the new PIN and pairing port.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Android TV
reconfigure.description: Update the network address or connect port for this Android TV.

error.missing_pairing_port: Pairing port is required for wireless pairing.
